name: Akashic Supply (Akashic)
body:
Benefit(s): You gain the ability to invest essence into a technological weapon you are carrying. For every point of essence invested, you may make one attack per round with that weapon which does not consume charges and which ammunition is magically generated for the attack. This ability does not enable you to make additional attacks per round with a weapon or make use of non-weapon items without consuming charges. You must load the generated ammunition normally, and the generated ammunition cannot be of any special materials or particularly sophisticated design (such as nanite canisters).

You gain one point of essence.
